title: 第13章 青渊破后天五方五行阐截二教仙皆惊 此为何阵第14章 截教首徒这叫不堪大用我等见过大师兄
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 青天白日。
江河秀丽山岳秀气。
一阵清风拂过虚空中站于云上的身影，将他披头散发吹动，同时也拨动着他的心弦。
“我……竟然败了？”
回过神来。
多宝道人面露苦涩。
他的内心好像什么碎裂，手里的火光剑也不见了，内心的唯我独尊念头……消散大半。
败了。
他败了啊！
入门数十万年跟随老师至今参悟剑道，连老师都夸赞他悟性极高，未来在剑道方面定会有一番大成就！
而他。
悟出了老师只挥动过一次的开天剑势。
破灭、毁灭、势如破竹、唯我独尊……
如此气势下，方才能够挥出毁天灭地的伐天一剑，此般连大罗金仙都做不到这一步，而他做到了！
可谁知……
还是输给了青渊？？
虽然青渊跟随老师数百万年之久。
可跟脚低劣福缘浅薄，用元始师伯的话说青渊根本无缘截教内门。
若非老师愿留青渊一线生机。
早就任其自生自灭。
早年间他也曾从南极仙翁与白鹤童子那儿听说青渊方入玄门的时候行为举止十分古怪，常说什么大势不可改小势可改，以及做出许多奇怪举动，亦是活泼好动各种尝试。
只可惜……
听闻一一失败。
不是遭天道警告便是降下劫难警示，若非老师庇护恐怕这青渊早就灰飞烟灭。
不甘心失败的青渊还曾闯过洪荒。
后来。
听说死里逃生方才能回到昆仑山，此后修道闭关愈发低沉、内向。
直至今时。
默默无闻中甚至出奇的差劲。
而他是在青渊不在山中的时候跟随的老师，后面入门的师妹师弟们也只认他，再加上他为人仗义实力强大，门人也服他。
故而。
他方才要挑战青渊。
争夺大师兄的位置成为唯一的玄门大弟子！
可谁知……
今日，便受挫了？？？
也不奇怪。
跟随老师数百万年之久的唯一玄门首徒，这么多年来怎么可能什么都不懂？
“青师兄……没想到你竟藏拙至今，倒是我小觑你了，剑道我甘拜下风，是我不如青师兄！”
多宝道人擦拭嘴角的血液。
重新爆发战意，喝道：“我跟随老师学习阵法之道，这些年来于此道有些见解勉强入道，青师兄可敢与我切磋阵道？”
content_en:
Blue sky and white sun.
The rivers are beautiful and the mountains are delicate.
A gust of breeze blew past the figure standing on the clouds in the void, blowing his disheveled hair, and at the same time plucked his heartstrings.
"I...actually lost?"
Come to your senses.
Taoist Duobao looked bitter.
His heart seemed to be broken, the fire sword in his hand disappeared, and most of the thoughts of self-centeredness in his heart... disappeared.
Defeated.
He lost!
He has followed his teacher for hundreds of thousands of years and has learned the way of kendo now. Even his teacher praised him for his extremely high understanding and he will definitely have great achievements in kendo in the future!
And he.
I realized the power of the Kaitian Sword that the teacher had only wielded once.
Destruction, destruction, overwhelming power, self-reliance...
With such momentum, he was able to swing a sword that destroyed the heaven and earth. Even Daluo Jinxian couldn't do this, but he did it!
But who knows...
Or lost to Qingyuan? ?
Although Qingyuan has been following his teacher for millions of years.
However, his footwork was inferior and his fortune was shallow. In the words of Uncle Yuanshi, Qingyuan had no chance of intercepting the inner sect of the sect.
If it weren't for the teacher who would have given Qingyuan a chance to survive.
It has long been left to fend for itself.
In his early years, he also heard from the Antarctic Immortal Old Man and the White Crane Boy that Qingyuan Fang behaved very strangely when he entered Xuanmen. He often said that the general situation cannot be changed and the small situation can be changed. He also made many strange behaviors and was lively and active in various attempts.
It's a pity...
I heard that one by one failed.
He was either warned by heaven or warned of disaster. If it weren't for the teacher's protection, Qingyuan would have been wiped out long ago.
Qingyuan, who was not willing to fail, had also gone through great times.
later.
I heard that only by escaping death can I return to Kunlun Mountain. After that, I became more and more depressed and introverted in monastic retreat.
Until now.
Even surprisingly bad in obscurity.
And he was the teacher who followed Qingyuan when he was not in the mountains. The junior sisters and junior brothers who started to follow him only recognized him. In addition, he was righteous and strong, so his disciples also respected him.
Therefore.
He was just about to challenge Qing Yuan.
Compete for the position of senior brother to become the only Taoist disciple!
But who knows...
Are you frustrated today? ? ?
Not surprising either.
How could the only Taoist disciple who has followed his teacher for millions of years not understand anything for so many years?
"Senior Brother Qing... I didn't expect that you would hide your clumsiness until now. I have underestimated you. I am willing to be inferior in swordsmanship. I am not as good as Senior Brother Qing!"
Taoist Duobao wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
He regained his fighting spirit and shouted: "I am learning the art of formations from my teacher. Over the years, I have gained some insights into this art and have barely entered the Tao. Senior Brother Qing, do you dare to discuss the art of formations with me?"
title_en: Chapter 13: Qingyuan broke through the Five Directions and Five Elements of Houtian. Both the Immortals of the two sects were shocked. Chapter 14: The first disciple of the Jie sect is called useless. We have seen the senior brother.
